package jose

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestSecurityJWEHeaderOverlap(t *testing.T) {
	key := make([]byte, 16)
	enc, err := NewEncrypter(A128GCM, Recipient{Algorithm: DIRECT, Key: key}, (&EncrypterOptions{}).WithHeader("test", ""))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	obj, err := enc.Encrypt([]byte("hello"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var msg map[string]*json.RawMessage
	if err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(obj.FullSerialize()), &msg); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	msg["unprotected"] = makeRawMessage([]byte(`{"test":"tampered"}`))
	b, err := json.Marshal(msg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err = ParseEncryptedJSON(string(b), []KeyAlgorithm{DIRECT}, []ContentEncryption{A128GCM}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "duplicate") {
		t.Errorf("duplicate protected/unprotected header accepted: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestSecurityJWSHeaderOverlap(t *testing.T) {
	for _, input := range []string{
		`{"payload":"AA","protected":"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInRlc3QiOm51bGx9","header":{"test":"tampered"},"signature":"AA"}`,
		`{"payload":"AA","signatures":[{"protected":"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInRlc3QiOm51bGx9","header":{"test":"tampered"},"signature":"AA"}]}`,
	} {
		if _, err := ParseSignedJSON(input, []SignatureAlgorithm{HS256}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "duplicate") {
			t.Errorf("duplicate JWS header accepted: %v", err)
		}
	}
}

func TestSecurityJWERecipientHeaderOverlap(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, protected, shared, recipient string }{
		{"protected recipient", `{"enc":"A128GCM","test":null}`, `{}`, `{"alg":"A128KW","test":"tampered"}`},
		{"shared recipient", `{"enc":"A128GCM"}`, `{"test":""}`, `{"alg":"A128KW","test":"tampered"}`},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			input := `{"protected":"` + base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(tc.protected)) + `","unprotected":` + tc.shared + `,"recipients":[{"header":` + tc.recipient + `,"encrypted_key":"AA"}],"iv":"AA","ciphertext":"AA","tag":"AA"}`
			if _, err := ParseEncryptedJSON(input, []KeyAlgorithm{A128KW}, []ContentEncryption{A128GCM}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "duplicate") {
				t.Errorf("duplicate recipient header accepted: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestSecurityDisjointMultiRecipientRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	key1, key2 := make([]byte, 16), make([]byte, 16)
	key2[0] = 1
	enc, err := NewMultiEncrypter(A128GCM, []Recipient{{Algorithm: A128KW, Key: key1, KeyID: "first"}, {Algorithm: A128KW, Key: key2, KeyID: "second"}}, (&EncrypterOptions{}).WithHeader("custom", "protected"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	obj, err := enc.Encrypt([]byte("disjoint recipient payload"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	parsed, err := ParseEncryptedJSON(obj.FullSerialize(), []KeyAlgorithm{A128KW}, []ContentEncryption{A128GCM})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	index, _, payload, err := parsed.DecryptMulti(key2)
	if err != nil || index != 1 || string(payload) != "disjoint recipient payload" {
		t.Errorf("valid multi-recipient round trip failed: index=%d payload=%q err=%v", index, payload, err)
	}
}
